decisions.statement: Nothing here runs.
A gateway is started with the port that gateway is asked to bind.
A gateway is started with the root every account is read under.
A started gateway hands back the port that gateway bound.
The port handed back is a number rather than a port that may be absent.
A started gateway hands back the stop that closes the gateway.
A started gateway hands back the flush that ends every stream held open.
A flush is told the reason every stream is ending.
Every option beside the port and the root is optional.
The effects a gateway reaches accounts through may be handed in.
The read answering the fallback provider may be handed in.
The directory a transport row lands in is handed in as a call rather than a path.
The idle span and the keepalive span are named in milliseconds.
A unix socket path handed in is where remote control is listened for.
The subagents held as stopped may be handed in.
A caller has the answer starting a gateway hands back for as long as that gateway runs.
No option here has a token.
No option here has an account name.
Nothing a gateway runs reads the refresh outcome hook these options have.
Nothing a gateway runs reads the terminal test these options have.
A refresh outcome is named here while no module under this domain makes a refresh outcome.
The root is required here while the effects handed in make that root unread.

definition: what starting a gateway is told and what a started gateway hands back
